turns.user_message: It's my 50th birthday this weekend! I'm bringing a group of 8 friends
We want to do it up big. Dinner, drinks, maybe a show
Can the restaurant do anything special for the birthday?
turns.agent_response:
Bringing, Michael Jordan’s Steak House is an excellent choice for a 50th birthday because our fine dining venues are known for their attentive service and ability to make large groups feel celebrated. 

For a party of eight, the restaurant can typically arrange for a special dessert presentation or coordinate a prime table to ensure your milestone feels significant. The atmosphere is sophisticated and high-energy, making it a perfect anchor for a night of "doing it up big." As this is one of our upscale destinations, business casual attire is recommended to match the refined setting. I can connect you with our host team to finalize the booking and ensure the restaurant knows you are celebrating your 50th so the staff can provide that extra level of attention. 

To help kick off your celebration, Mohegan Sun would love to treat you to a $25 dining credit to use at any of our restaurants during your visit. Beyond the meal, would you prefer the high-energy atmosphere of a major concert at the Mohegan Sun Arena or a more intimate performance at one of our other venues?
